primary_failures: positive memory treatments mixed helpful and nonhelpful evidence
EvoEmo formal observable states are metadata OOD

scientific_target.estimand: whether one supervised pre-item-retrieval router can jointly learn when to enable Strategy and which available memory sources to call under a conservative quality-risk-cost tradeoff

unified_router_definition.full_conceptual_action_space: memory subset M0/MP/MS/ME/MPMS/MPME/MSME/MPMSME crossed with R0/RS
unified_router_definition.legal_action_mask: source availability removes impossible actions before selection
unified_router_definition.ESConv_is_not_a_separate_policy: it is the boundary case in which MP/MS/ME are structurally unavailable and the same PM chooses between M0+R0 and M0+RS
unified_router_definition.EvoEmo_is_not_a_separate_policy: it is the multi-session region of the same state-action function with memory available

abstention_M0.positive_support: states where every resource is irrelevant or harmful
abstention_M0.required_contrast: M0 control versus one-resource placebo or harm treatment

MP_profile.positive_support: one annotated helpful profile item and no other selected item
MP_profile.negative_support: matched irrelevant placebo and harmful profile item

MS_summary.positive_support: one annotated helpful session-summary item and no other selected item
MS_summary.negative_support: matched irrelevant placebo and harmful summary item

ME_event.positive_support: one annotated helpful event item and no other selected item
ME_event.negative_support: matched irrelevant placebo and harmful event item

RS_strategy.positive_support: one relevant strategy card versus R0 under the same prompt across both memory-unavailable and memory-available backgrounds
RS_strategy.negative_support: R0 versus one mismatched or harmful strategy card
RS_strategy.gold_strategy_boundary: ESConv gold strategy may be a silver relevance labeling function but never response-quality gold

multi_source.training_rule: compose only source treatments that individually passed uptake and include explicit source-source and source-by-RS interaction contrasts

clean_contrast_contract.control: same state with M0 or R0 as appropriate
clean_contrast_contract.helpful_treatment: exactly one evaluator-annotated helpful item from the target source
clean_contrast_contract.irrelevant_placebo: exactly one matched irrelevant item kept separate from harmful evidence
required_pre_scale_checks: generator uptake is positive for helpful treatment
generator uptake is nonpositive or safely ignored for harmful and irrelevant treatments
response differences are large enough to be judged above the frozen practical margin
no prompt token budget seed retriever or generator drift within a contrast

ESConv.scientific_role: single-session boundary-condition test of the same PM's selective Strategy use and immediate response quality
ESConv.claim_boundary: does not test memory or longitudinal personalization

EvoEmo_ES_MemEval_derived.scientific_role: development-informed multi-session test of the same PM's joint memory-source and Strategy allocation
EvoEmo_ES_MemEval_derived.training_support_source: outcome-free operational envelope and synthetic metadata augmentation never external response or judge outcome
EvoEmo_ES_MemEval_derived.external_observable_range_use_must_be_di: development-informed rather than pristine external evaluation

weak_supervision.quality: blinded within-state pairwise preference with judge family retained separately
weak_supervision.evidence_handling: claim-to-visible-evidence audit with exact quote and abstention
weak_supervision.risk: action-applicable explicit flags; N/A is not zero
weak_supervision.structural_need_and_harm: high-precision silver labeling functions not response-quality gold
weak_supervision.judge_disagreement: retain as uncertainty or abstain; majority vote is not gold
weak_supervision.human_anchor: small train-only descriptive calibration and adjudication sample not bulk gold
weak_supervision.existing_absolute_labels: noisy auxiliary lineage only never the primary target

small_sample_learning.stage_1: shared regularized source-need and strategy-need heads from pre-retrieval observables across both domains
small_sample_learning.stage_2: shared regularized realized-benefit residual heads from clean paired effects with a small frozen set of source-source and source-by-RS interactions
small_sample_learning.grouping: user or dialogue grouped cross-validation and bootstrap
small_sample_learning.domain_weighting: equal top-level domain then group then state then contrast for statistical balance only; no domain-specific policy or domain feature
small_sample_learning.multi_source_interaction: explicit shrinkage toward nonpositive interaction unless supported

pretraining_gates.gate_1_surface_and_lineage: all deterministic corpus leakage mechanism and selected-item checks pass
pretraining_gates.gate_2_clean_treatment: zero helpful-plus-nonhelpful contamination in positive clean contrasts
pretraining_gates.gate_3_mechanism_uptake: pre-registered small pilot shows helpful uptake and harmful or placebo suppression
pretraining_gates.gate_4_measurement: human-anchor and judge labeling functions have reportable reliability; unsupported rows abstain
pretraining_gates.gate_5_train_only_learnability: group-held-out component prediction beats M0-only and structural-rule baselines by frozen margin
pretraining_gates.gate_6_external_input_support: ESConv and EvoEmo observable-state severe OOD each at or below 0.10

split_discipline.train: construct contrasts fit weak label model and component models
split_discipline.calibration: one frozen threshold and viability evaluation after train-only design is fixed
split_discipline.internal_test: sealed until candidate and thresholds are frozen; consumed once
split_discipline.external: observable support may be checked without outcomes; response and judge outcomes remain sealed until study freeze
split_discipline.if_calibration_not_supported: freeze NOT_SUPPORTED and do not open internal or external outcomes

reuse: repaired V8.19.2 states and deterministic lineage
existing outcomes as noisy diagnostics and cost provenance
existing judge rows as separate weak labeling functions
must_regenerate: clean single-item helpful placebo and harm response contrasts
a small mechanism-matched human anchor packet after new responses exist

stopping_rule.failure_of_any_pretraining_gate: stop before scale-up and report the failed capability
stopping_rule.success_is_not_guaranteed: the contract guarantees that an unlearnable treatment is not scaled not that a learned PM must pass
